in_marathi.name: Bhaswati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blessings of the Goddess
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhaswati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhaswati is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Bhas’, which means ‘to speak’. This name signifies the blessings of the Goddess. The name is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Bhaswati is associated with the Goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, learning, and music.
